decisions.notebook: Game 1: Garganacl walls burned Choice Scarf Garchomp effectively with Purifying Salt and Recover/Body Press. Opponent brought Rotom-Mow (Timid, Life Orb, Leaf Storm/Thunderbolt/Volt Switch/Protect) and Garchomp (Jolly, Choice Scarf, Rock Slide/Earthquake/Dragon Claw/Protect).

decisions.rationale: 2v1 vs last Garganacl. Leaf Storm is 93-204% super-effective, Dragon Claw adds 20-41% and bypasses Wide Guard which would block Earthquake. Double single-target ensures KO even if Garg Recovers or Wide Guards, Rotom Levitate makes EQ unnecessary risk.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Mega Zard Y Modest Drought HeatWave/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/Recover/SaltCure/BodyPress, Clefable Unaware Sitrus, Goodra-H Shuca SapSipper. Our tech: Rotom LO Leaf Storm 2x Garg, Thunderbolt single-target bypasses Wide Guard, Garchomp Scarf EQ blocked by Wide Guard so use Dragon Claw in endgame.

reflections.summary: Relying on Charizard-Mega-Y and Venusaur against Choice Scarf Garchomp and Extreme Speed Dragonite left our team exposed to fast Rock Slide spread and priority finishing, leaving Garganacl isolated against Rotom-Mow.
reflections.adjustment: At Team Preview, deprioritize Charizard-Mega-Y sun mode; lead Dragapult with Garganacl to pressure Sneasler and Garchomp without taking heavy Rock Slide spread damage, saving counter-threats to eliminate Rotom-Mow early.
reflections.notebook: Opponent movesets & items: Garchomp (Jolly, Choice Scarf: Rock Slide, Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Protect); Rotom-Mow (Timid, Life Orb: Leaf Storm, Thunderbolt, Volt Switch, Protect); Sneasler (Jolly, Focus Sash: Fake Out, Close Combat, Gunk Shot, Protect); Dragonite (Jolly, Lum Berry: Tailwind, Rock Slide, Extreme Speed, Protect). Strategic note: Eliminate Rotom-Mow early so Garganacl can win late-game against Choice Scarf Garchomp.

reflections.summary: Won because our 4 directly countered their sun+Wide Guard plan. Opp brought Zard-Y/Venusaur/Garg/Dragapult and relied on Garganacl Wide Guard (6 uses) to block Rock Slide/EQ. Our Rotom-Mow Thunderbolt bypasses Wide Guard to chip Venusaur/Zard through Protect, Leaf Storm is super-effective vs Garganacl, Dragonite Extreme Speed cleaned 1% Venusaur and 15% Mega Zard-Y, and Scarf Garchomp Dragon Claw gave non-spread damage when EQ/Rock Slide were denied. Team preview was correct - no Mega needed vs
reflections.adjustment: Next game keep Rotom/Garchomp/Dragonite core but don't waste Rock Slide PP into Wide Guard - lead Rotom+Dragonite to pressure sun immediately with Thunderbolt+Extreme Speed, save Garchomp Dragon Claw for endgame vs Garganacl, and use Sneasler Fake Out if they lead Garg to deny first Wide Guard.
reflections.notebook: Opp Game1 bring: Mega Zard Y Modest Drought HeatWave/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect + Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll Sludge Bomb/Weather Ball/Earth Power/Protect + Dragapult Jolly DragonFang DragonDarts/PhantomForce/WillOWisp/Protect + Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/Recover/SaltCure/BodyPress. Benched Clefable Unaware Sitrus FollowMe/Moonblast/HelpingHand/Protect and Goodra-H Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew. Tendency: heavy Wide Guard spam to block spread, Protect stall low HP sweepers, sun mode. Our tech: Rotom-Mow LO Leaf Storm 2x Garg, Thunderbolt bypasses Wide Guard, Dragonite Lum Jolly Tailwind/Rock Slide/Extreme Speed/Protect priority cleans sun, Garchomp Scarf Jolly EQ/Rock Slide/Dragon Claw/Protect - use Dragon Claw when Wide Guard up. Plan next: lead Fake Out or immediate single-target pressure vs Garg+Venusaur.
